section_header: FRONT AXLE AND SUSPENSION — Front Axle Hub
title: Front Axle Hub

content.description: Illustration showing front axle hub assembly with suspension components and wheel

content.text: If preload is less than specification, tighten the nut slightly and check again.
If preload is excessive, loosen the nut and, using a socket in your hand, retighten it as tight as possible. Check the preload again.

content.description: Illustration showing installation of lock cap, cotter pin and hub grease cap on wheel hub assembly

content.text: 6. INSTALL LOCK CAP, COTTER PIN AND HUB GREASE CAP
NOTE: If the cotter pin hole does not line up, correct by tightening the nut by the smallest amount possible.
Install brake caliper on the disc. Torque the mounting bolts.
